Single cell RNA-seq of one PBS-treated and one AEC-treated mouse. Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender.
This script was written for Seurat v4. To run it with Seurat v5, keep `options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")` in the setup chunk.

Loom file for pySCENIC and downstream analysis of the regulons by immune cell type.
Starts from the objects in `data/cell/` saved by `01_QC_integration_annotation.Rmd`. pySCENIC output: `results/cell/SCENIC/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r data preparation of SCENIC}
## Read data
raw_data <-  readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune.rds")
raw_data<-SetIdent(raw_data,value = "Celltypes")
dim(raw_data)

raw_data <-DietSeurat(raw_data)
write.csv(raw_data@meta.data[,"Celltypes", drop=FALSE], file="results/cell/SCENIC/cellAnnot_Celltypes.csv", quote=FALSE)

## Create a loom file with the filtered data, to be used in pySCENIC:
data_counts<-raw_data@assays$RNA@counts
row_attrs<-list()
row_attrs[["Gene"]]<-data_counts@Dimnames[[1]]

col_attrs<-list()
col_attrs[["CellID"]]<-data_counts@Dimnames[[2]]
col_attrs[["nGene"]]<-Matrix::colSums(data_counts>0)
col_attrs[["nUMI"]]<-Matrix::colSums(data_counts)

create("results/cell/SCENIC/Immune_SCENIC.loom", data_counts, gene.attrs = row_attrs, cell.attrs = col_attrs)
```

pySCENIC was run on `Immune_SCENIC.loom`. The output files are read below.
```{r SCENIC results}
data <-  readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune.rds")

scenic_regulon_umap<-read.table("results/cell/SCENIC/scenic_umap.txt", row.names = 1)
scenic_auc_mtx<-read.table("results/cell/SCENIC/scenic_auc_mtx.txt", header=TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
scenic_RSS_Celltypes<-read.table("results/cell/SCENIC/scenic_RegulonSpecificityScores_Celltypes.txt",sep = '\t', header=TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

## Make up Seurat object
colnames(scenic_regulon_umap)<-c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
reduction_regulon_umap <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = as.matrix(scenic_regulon_umap),
  stdev = as.numeric(apply(scenic_regulon_umap, 2, sd)),
  key = "umap",
  assay = "RNA"
)
data@reductions[["umap_regulon"]]<-reduction_regulon_umap

p_gene<-DimPlot(data, reduction = "umap", group.by="Celltypes", shuffle = TRUE, label = T)+ ggtitle("Celltypes_UMAP")
p_regulon<-DimPlot(data, reduction = "umap_regulon", group.by="Celltypes", shuffle = TRUE)+ggtitle("regulon_UMAP")
ggsave("results/cell/SCENIC/DimPlot_UMAP_Celltypes.pdf", plot_grid(ncol = 2, p_gene, p_regulon), width=12, height=5)


##
RSS_matrix<-t(scenic_RSS_Celltypes)
AUC_matrix<-t(scenic_auc_mtx)

regulons<-rownames(RSS_matrix)
identical(regulons, rownames(AUC_matrix))
# TRUE

topreg<-list()
for (i in seq(ncol(RSS_matrix))) {
  topreg[[i]]<-head(regulons[order(RSS_matrix[,i], decreasing = TRUE)], 30)
}
names(topreg)<-colnames(RSS_matrix)


data@assays[["AUC"]]<-CreateAssayObject(data=AUC_matrix)
data@assays[["AUC"]]@key<-"auc_"
data@reductions[["umap_regulon"]]@assay.used<-"AUC"

## Plot AUC on UMAP
for (i in names(topreg)) {
  for (feature in topreg[[i]]) {
    gene<-sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", feature, perl=TRUE)
    data@active.assay<-"RNA"
    p_gene<-FeaturePlot(data, features =gene, reduction = "umap", order=TRUE)
    data@active.assay<-"AUC"
    p_regulon<-FeaturePlot(data, features=feature, reduction = "umap", order=TRUE)
    ggsave(paste0("results/cell/SCENIC/AUC_featurePlot_", i, "_", gene, ".pdf"), plot_grid(ncol = 2, p_gene, p_regulon), width=8, height=4)
  }
}

topreg_df<-data.frame(Regulon="", Gene="", Celltypes="")
for (i in colnames(RSS_matrix)) {
  features<-regulons[order(RSS_matrix[,i], decreasing = TRUE)]
  for (feature in features) {
    gene<-sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", feature, perl=TRUE)
    topreg_df<-rbind(topreg_df, c(feature, gene, i))
  }
}
topreg_df<-topreg_df[-1,]
write.csv(topreg_df, "results/cell/SCENIC/AUC_regulon_list_all.csv", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)


## Dot plot
scenic_auc_mtx_binary<-read.table("results/cell/SCENIC/scenic_auc_mtx_binary.txt", skip=1, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
scenic_auc_thresholds<-read.table("results/cell/SCENIC/scenic_auc_mtx_binary_thresholds.txt", skip=1, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

AUC_binary<-t(scenic_auc_mtx_binary)

identical(regulons, sub("_(", "(", rownames(scenic_auc_thresholds), fixed=TRUE))
# TRUE
rownames(AUC_binary)<-regulons
rownames(scenic_auc_thresholds)<-regulons

data@assays[["AUC_binary"]]<-CreateAssayObject(data=AUC_binary)
data@assays[["AUC_binary"]]@key<-"aucB_"

saveRDS(data, "results/cell/SCENIC/SCENIC.rds")

## Top 10
RSS_matrix<-RSS_matrix[,sort(colnames(RSS_matrix))]
top10_reg_df<-data.frame(Regulon="", Gene="", Celltypes="")
for (i in colnames(RSS_matrix)) {
  features<-head(regulons[order(RSS_matrix[,i], decreasing = TRUE)], 10)
  for (feature in features) {
    gene<-sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", feature, perl=TRUE)
    top10_reg_df<-rbind(top10_reg_df, c(feature, gene, i))
  }
}
top10_reg_df<-top10_reg_df[-1,]
write.csv(top10_reg_df, "results/cell/SCENIC/AUC_regulon_list_top10.csv", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

# genes is either a number (top regulons per cell type) or a vector of gene names
SCENICDot = function(data, RSS_matrix, genes){
RSS_matrix<-RSS_matrix[,sort(colnames(RSS_matrix))]
top_reg_df<-data.frame(Regulon="", Gene="", Celltypes="")
for (i in colnames(RSS_matrix)) {
  features<-regulons[order(RSS_matrix[,i], decreasing = TRUE)]
  if (is.numeric(genes)) features <- head(features, genes)
  for (feature in features) {
    gene<-sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", feature, perl=TRUE)
    top_reg_df<-rbind(top_reg_df, c(feature, gene, i))
  }
}
top_reg_df<-top_reg_df[-1,]
if (!is.numeric(genes)) top_reg_df<- top_reg_df[top_reg_df$Gene %in% genes,]
top_reg_df_plot<-top_reg_df[!duplicated(top_reg_df$Gene),1:2]

data@active.assay<-"AUC"
data_AUC_raw <- FetchData(object = data, vars = top_reg_df_plot$Regulon)
data_AUC_raw$Celltypes <- factor(x = data[["Celltypes", drop = TRUE]])

data@active.assay<-"AUC_binary"
data_AUC_binary <- FetchData(object = data, vars = top_reg_df_plot$Regulon)
data_AUC_binary$Celltypes <- factor(x = data[["Celltypes", drop = TRUE]])

# Average activity per subtype----
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes <- lapply(X = levels(x = data_AUC_raw$Celltypes), FUN = function(ident) {
  data.use <- data_AUC_raw[data_AUC_raw$Celltypes == ident,
                           1:(ncol(x = data_AUC_raw) - 1), drop = FALSE]
  avg.exp <- apply(X = data.use, MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x) {
    return(mean(x = x))
  })
  pct.exp <- apply(X = data.use, MARGIN = 2, FUN = PercentAbove,
                   threshold = 0)
  return(list(avg.exp = avg.exp, pct.exp = pct.exp))
})
names(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes) <- levels(x = data_AUC_raw$Celltypes)

data_AUC_raw_Celltypes <- lapply(X = names(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes), FUN = function(x) {
  data.use <- as.data.frame(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes[[x]])
  data.use$features.plot <- rownames(x = data.use)
  data.use$Celltypes <- x
  return(data.use)
})
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes <- do.call(what = "rbind", args = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes)

data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_scaled <- sapply(X = unique(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$features.plot),
                                             FUN = function(x) {
                                               data.use <- data_AUC_raw_Celltypes[data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$features.plot == x, "avg.exp"]
                                               data.use <- scale(x = data.use)
                                               data.use <- MinMax(data = data.use, min = -2.5, max = 2.5)
                                               return(data.use)
                                             })
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$avg.exp.scaled <- as.vector(x = t(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_scaled))

# Percent activated per subtype----
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary <- lapply(X = levels(x = data_AUC_binary$Celltypes), FUN = function(ident) {
  data.use <- data_AUC_binary[data_AUC_binary$Celltypes == ident,
                              1:(ncol(x = data_AUC_binary) - 1), drop = FALSE]
  pct.act <- apply(X = data.use, MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x) {
    return(length(x = x[x == 1])/length(x = x))
  })
  return(list(pct.act = pct.act))
})
names(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary) <- levels(x = data_AUC_binary$Celltypes)

data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary <- lapply(X = names(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary), FUN = function(x) {
  data.use <- as.data.frame(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary[[x]])
  data.use$features.plot <- rownames(x = data.use)
  data.use$Celltypes <- x
  return(data.use)
})
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary <- do.call(what = "rbind", args = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary)

data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$pct.act<-data_AUC_raw_Celltypes_binary$pct.act
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$features.plot <- factor(x = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$features.plot, levels = rev(top_reg_df_plot$Regulon))
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$pct.exp <- data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$pct.exp * 100
data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$pct.act <- data_AUC_raw_Celltypes$pct.act * 100

ggplot(data = data_AUC_raw_Celltypes, mapping = aes_string(x = "Celltypes", y = "features.plot")) + geom_point(mapping = aes_string(size = "pct.act", color = "avg.exp.scaled")) +
  scale_radius(range = c(0, 6), limits = c(NA, NA)) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = "Percent Activated")) +
  labs(title = "Regulons", x="", y="") + theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue",mid = "grey", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "Average Activity"))
}

SCENICDot(data, RSS_matrix, genes=50)

genes = c("Jdp2", "Gbx1", "Elf4", "Chd2", "Zfp78", "Tfeb", "Sp4", "Foxp1", "Nfe2l2", "Sp3", "Hivep1", "Etv5", "Zfp704", "Ube2k", "Sfpq", "Chd1", "Mbd2", "Mlxipl", "Ikzf2", "Gabpa", "Nrf1", "Smad1", "Ehf", "Nfkb1", "Mafk", "Mtf1", "Zbtb5", "Irf2", "Rel", "Thrb", "Bach1", "Jund", "Cebpg", "Elf1", "Pbx1", "Ikzf3", "Creb1", "Pou1f1", "Etv4", "Setdb1", "Fosb", "Relb", "Hltf", "Atf3", "Epas1", "Klf6", "Zfp516", "Stat2", "Tfdp2", "Sall2", "Bclaf1", "Zfp189", "Bptf", "Gata2", "Heyl", "Foxo1", "Zbtb14", "Elk1", "Gata3", "Jun", "Etv6", "Clock", "Arntl2", "Eomes", "Hinfp", "Sp1", "Etv1", "Klf7", "Egr1", "Rxrb", "Max", "Hdx", "Elk4", "Zfp456")
SCENICDot(data, RSS_matrix, genes=genes)
```
